{"script":"tmp=temp_workspace
mkdir -p "$tmp"
matches="$tmp/matches.txt"
reg_matches="$tmp/regular_matches.txt"
reg_count="$tmp/regular_count.txt"
decision_file="$tmp/decision_prepare.txt"
: > "$matches"
find /working -name 'workspace' 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r p; do
  t=$(stat -c '%F' -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown')
  printf '%s\t%s\n' "$p" "$t" >> "$matches"
done
awk -F '\t' '$2=="regular file" {print $1}' "$matches" > "$reg_matches" 2>/dev/null || true
sort -u "$reg_matches" 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -r "$p" ] && echo "$p"
done > "$tmp/regular_list.tmp"
# move to reg_count file (will be overwritten)
if [ -s "$tmp/regular_list.tmp" ]; then
  mv "$tmp/regular_list.tmp" "$reg_count"
else
  : > "$reg_count"
fi
count=$(wc -l < "$reg_count" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
# append COUNT line
echo "COUNT: $count" >> "$reg_count"
# decision_prepare
if [ "$count" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "greater_than_zero: yes" > "$decision_file"
else
  echo "greater_than_zero: no" > "$decision_file"
fi
echo "ready: yes" >> "$decision_file"
# final output
if [ "$count" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then
  echo yes
else
  echo no
fi
"}
